definitions.explanation: The flat triangular bone at the back of the shoulder. An important bone connecting the arm to the body.

examples.japanese: {肩甲骨|けんこうこつ}のストレッチをする。
examples.english: I do stretches for my shoulder blades.

examples.japanese: {肩甲骨|けんこうこつ}の{周|まわ}りがこっている。
examples.english: The area around my shoulder blades is stiff.

examples.japanese: {肩甲骨|けんこうこつ}を{寄|よ}せるように{動|うご}かす。
examples.english: Move your shoulder blades as if bringing them together.

notes:
{肩甲骨|けんこうこつ} is commonly mentioned in fitness and massage contexts.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {肩甲骨|けんこうこつ}を{動|うご}かす: to move the shoulder blades
- {肩甲骨|けんこうこつ}{周|まわ}り: the area around the shoulder blades
- {肩甲骨|けんこうこつ}はがし: shoulder blade release (massage technique)

FITNESS CONTEXT:
Proper {肩甲骨|けんこうこつ} mobility is emphasized in many exercise programs for posture improvement.
